```{r}

# Read the expression matrix

# Inspect the format (often the first column is gene names, the rest are barcodes)
head(expr_matrix2[, 1:5])
```

```{r}
rownames(expr_matrix2) <- expr_matrix2[, 1]
expr_matrix2 <- expr_matrix2[, -1]
```

```{r}
# Reload from scratch
expr_matrix2 <- fread("GSE109816/GSE109816_normal_heart_umi_matrix.csv.gz", data.table = FALSE)

# Set gene names as rownames
rownames(expr_matrix2) <- expr_matrix2[[1]]

# Remove the first column (which just contained gene names)
expr_matrix2 <- expr_matrix2[, -1]

# Convert to matrix
expr_matrix2 <- as.matrix(expr_matrix2)

# Create Seurat object
seurat_heart2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = expr_matrix2, project = "GSE109816_Heart", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

```

```{r}
# Normalize
seurat_sampleCM_norm <- NormalizeData(seurat_cardiomyocytes2)

# Feature
```

```{r}
seurat_combined_with_CMs <- merge(seurat_combined, y = seurat_sampleCM_norm)
```

# Combine Counts from All Groups Into New "seurat_combined"
```{r}
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(seurat_combined_with_CMs@assays$RNA$counts.GSE109816_Heart), 
                          rownames(seurat_combined_with_CMs@assays$RNA$counts.SeuratProject))

counts_heart <- seurat_combined_with_CMs@assays$RNA$counts.GSE109816_Heart[common_genes, ]
counts_seurat <- seurat_combined_with_CMs@assays$RNA$counts.SeuratProject[common_genes, ]

combined_counts2 <- cbind(counts_heart, counts_seurat)

# Create Seurat object with combined counts
seurat_combined_with_CMs_final <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = combined_counts2)
```


# Feature, Scale, and PCA
```{r}
# Normalize 
seurat_combined_with_CMs_final <- NormalizeData(seurat_combined_with_CMs_final)

# Continue
seurat_combined_with_CMs_final <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_combined_with_CMs_final)
seurat_combined_with_CMs_final <- ScaleData(seurat_combined_with_CMs_final)
seurat_combined_with_CMs_final <- RunPCA(seurat_combined_with_CMs_final)

print(seurat_combined_with_CMs_final[["pca"]])
```















































































































# Find Features (Most Variable Genes) and Anchors (Batch Effects)
```{r}
# List datasets (change clean to norm 3/6/25)
seurat_objects2 <- list(seurat_sampleAd_norm, seurat_sampleCF_norm, seurat_sampleEC_norm, seurat_sampleNeo_norm, seurat_sampleSMC_norm,
                       seurat_sampleCM_norm)

# Ident integration features
# The function identifies genes that show variation across the datasets, which are likely to contribute to the biological signal during # the integration process. This helps reduce noise and ensures that the integration process focuses on the relevant aspects of the data.
features2 <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat_objects2)

# returns only the genes that are present in all Seurat objects.
common_features2 <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(seurat_objects2, function(x) rownames(GetAssayData(x, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"))))

# By subsetting each dataset to only include the common features, you ensure that the integration step is performed on the exact same 
# set of genes across all datasets. 
seurat_objects2 <- lapply(seurat_objects2, function(x) {
  x <- subset(x, features = common_features2)
  return(x)
})

# Align
# Anchors are pairs of cells from different datasets that are biologically similar and can be used as reference points 
# for aligning the datasets.
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat_objects2, anchor.features = features2)
```


# Integrate Data (Make seurat_combined)
```{r}
# integrate data
seurat_combined_with_CMs <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors)
```
